attribution_credits_target_ck.name: attribution_credits_target_ck
attribution_credits_target_ck.value: "attribution_credits"."conversion_event_id" IS NOT NULL OR "attribution_credits"."revenue_event_id" IS NOT NULL

distribution_targets_relevance_ck.name: distribution_targets_relevance_ck
distribution_targets_relevance_ck.value: relevance IS NULL OR (relevance >= 0 AND relevance <= 100)

experiments_counts_ck.name: experiments_counts_ck
experiments_counts_ck.value: (control_n IS NULL OR control_n >= 0) AND (variant_n IS NULL OR variant_n >= 0) AND (control_conversions IS NULL OR (control_conversions >= 0 AND (control_n IS NULL OR control_conversions <= control_n))) AND (variant_conversions IS NULL OR (variant_conversions >= 0 AND (variant_n IS NULL OR variant_conversions <= variant_n)))

recommendations_open_opportunity_uq.name: recommendations_open_opportunity_uq
recommendations_open_opportunity_uq.where: status IN ('PROPOSED', 'APPROVED') AND opportunity_id IS NOT NULL

recommendations_open_dedupe_uq.name: recommendations_open_dedupe_uq
recommendations_open_dedupe_uq.where: status IN ('PROPOSED', 'APPROVED') AND dedupe_key IS NOT NULL

recommendations_measure_idx.name: recommendations_measure_idx
recommendations_measure_idx.where: executed_at IS NOT NULL AND outcome_label IS NULL
